rules.heading: THE AUSPISIOUSNESS OR THE INAUSPICIOUSNESS OF THE UPANAYANA SAMSKARA

planetary.freeform: Strong position of the planets who are the Lords of the Vedas, Sun, Moon, and Jupiter. For Rigveda: Thursday, 9/12 Lagnas, strength of Jupiter; for Yajurveda: Friday, 2/7 Lagnas, strength of Venus; for Samaveda: Tuesday, 1/8 Lagnas; for Atharvaveda: Wednesday, 3/6 Lagnas, strength of Mercury.

exclusions: Jupiter and Venus in enemy's sign
Jupiter and Venus in deep debilitation sign
Jupiter and Venus defeated in planetary war
rules.notes: Planetary strengths and specific weekdays/lagnas according to the Vedas are auspicious for the Upanayana ceremony, while debilitated or defeated lords are harmful.

rules.heading: EXCEPION OF THE MONTH OF THE BIRTH ETC. IN THE UPANAYANA SAMSKARA

planetary.freeform: Performing Upanayana on the birth nakshatra, month, lagna, and tithi is beneficial for the eldest child of Brahmin varna, or for Kshetriya/Vaishya children born after the first conception.

rules.notes: Using birth-time factors (nakshatra, month, lagna, tithi) is exceptionally auspicious for Upanayana under specific birth-order and varna conditions.
